name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows, then lower slowly.

source.title: Lateral Raise (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
cues: Lower more slowly than you lift.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Raise
keyframes.cue: Lift your arms out to shoulder height.
